note: Plot 7 (strained-moments.html). Every station, line and quarter-hour from 06:00 to 22:00 (London clock) for each day in days. crowd: the crowding index (% of the station's record) with closed, exit-only and fully suspended stations left out, exactly as in every other plot; usual: the same usual as Plot 6 (the station's median for this time on other days of the same type, Mon-Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun, from the 15 minutes either side, the day itself left out); trains and trains_usual: trains with a live prediction per line and the usual for that hour and day type with disrupted hours left out. Arrays are one byte per value, station (or line) first, then day, then quarter-hour: crowd and usual decode as 200 * (b / 254) ** 2, trains as b; 255 means no value. status: [day, first quarter-hour, quarter-hour after the last, line, 1 minor delays / 2 severe delays or reduced service / 3 part suspended or part closed / 4 suspended or closed]. closed: [day, first, after last, station, 1 closed / 2 exit only]. lines: the ten lines, each with its routes from TfL's route sequences (station indices).
